bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — West Thornton CPZ, London Borough of Croydon (outer zone). Permit holders park in marked bays; visitors pay by phone (RingGo) or use a visitor permit. Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.times: Operational hours are shown on zone entry signs — the council does not publish a per-zone hours table
bays.tariff: Pay-by-phone bays (12-hour max stay), Mon-Sat during CPZ hours: 30 mins £0.78/£0.89/£1.05, 1 hr £1.57/£1.78/£2.10, 2 hrs £3.18/£3.61/£4.25, 4 hrs £6.37/£7.22/£8.50, 8 hrs and over £12.67/£14.36/£16.90 (Band 1/Band 2/Band 3; the schedule lists every 30-minute step). Bands (CO2): Band 1 <1 g/km, Band 2 1-138 g/km, Band 3 >138 g/km, pre-March-2001 vehicles and non-Euro-6 diesels
bays.pay: RingGo (app, web or phone 0203 046 0010) or cash/card at PayPoint; visitor permits via residents
bays.permits: Resident permit (annual, charges from 7 April 2026): Band 1 £39, Band 2 (1-90 g/km) £89, Band 3 (91-130) £143, Band 4 (131-190) £199, Band 5 (>190) £342; pre-March-2001 cars £342 (over 1601cc) or £171 (under); second permit +£57, third +£171 (renewal only). Monthly permits also available. Visitor permits: £1.60/£1.90/£2.20 (Band 1/Band 2/Band 3) per half day; visitor day permit £2.60 (council charges schedule and visitor permits page)

bays.restriction: Pay-and-display / pay-by-phone parking bay on The Causeway
bays.tariff: £1.80 per hour (Merton street parking charges, from 21 April 2026)
bays.pay: RingGo — location code 19380; or pay-and-display ticket machine; paying by mobile or internet adds a 20p service charge (council charges page)

bays.restriction: Permit parking area HB1 — Hackbridge, Sutton. Permit holders only in marked bays during the controlled hours
bays.tariff: Resident permits are charged by CO2 emissions group: Group 1 £54, Group 2 £70, Group 3 £98, Group 4 £130, Group 5 £174 per year. Every household is entitled to 50 hours of free visitor vouchers per year; additional visitor vouchers cost £35.50 per 50 hours or £71 per 100 hours (Sutton Council).
bays.pay: Permit holders only during the controlled hours (resident permit or visitor voucher)
